team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: when the equipping character heals a party member, the Yearning effect records the healing done over 6s (overflow healing included, capped at 15,000). It then becomes Waves of Days Past: the active character's Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst deal DMG increased by 8% of the recorded healing. That is a flat Additive Base DMG Bonus, so it uses the five *_dmgInc keys (the same shape as Faruzan's A4), not a DMG% bucket. Team scope: the set is worn by a healer and the buff lands on whoever is active. The effect is removed after 5 hits or 10s, so weight the rotation accordingly rather than assuming every hit gets it. States are the recorded healing; 15,000 is the in-game cap and gives the maximum +1,200.
